propositions: KNOWN_CAPABILITIES does not include multi-project-bridge, preventing older binaries from recognizing the capability requirement and failing closed on writes
when multi-project-bridge is registered in KNOWN_CAPABILITIES, a store record declaring it should classify as compatible instead of raising StoreIncompatibleError
a store without a .store-compat.json file should pass through as implicit legacy without triggering compatibility checks
a store with a .store-compat.json record declaring an unknown capability must refuse write operations via the lock gate while read operations (list, show, search) remain available
a malformed .store-compat.json record must raise an error rather than being treated as absent, to prevent bypassing the compatibility gate
